question: Does the bright-fragmented / dim-clean anchor-topology dichotomy generalize across a PA-stratified cohort?
hypothesis: The clean 3-5 dim-cluster enumerator pattern from seed 89 holds cohort-wide.
narrative_md: On the 11-seed PA-stratified cohort, bright fragmentation is universal (11/11) but the clean dim-enumerator pattern (3-6 clusters, top-3 mass >= 85%) holds only on ~5/11 seeds (10/89 strict, +44, ~+28/91 relaxed). Cleanness correlates with |C_t| < 100 at the dim extreme. The dim clean-enumerator path is opportunistic per-seed, not universal; only the bright passage-validator path generalizes. Refutes the seed-89-generalizes hypothesis.
